title: CUT reference exact-frame manifest v2
description: Closed exact-frame evidence, including same-invocation GeoAnnotation, MapCamera, DiagramLayout, LocalSpace execution, anchored-path resolution, composition-wide affine transform preflight, retained-media local-compositor, PlanarTrack projective execution, and ResponsiveStack execution. Historical MapCamera v1-v4 and direct retained-media receipt branches retain their exact closed meanings; current MapCamera v5 publishes renderer-invocation canonical-raster cache outcomes without claiming a persistent cache, while current affine-preflight, anchored-path, and retained-media-under-compositor writers use additive branches inside this outer frame-v2 manifest.

calloutLayers.description: Completed same-invocation generic collision-aware CalloutLayer receipts. Omitted when no CalloutLayer executes so historical frame-v2 manifests remain valid.

camera3Ds.description: Completed same-invocation bounded planar Camera3D projection and compositing receipts. Omitted when no Camera3D executes so historical frame-v2 manifests remain valid.

mediaCamera2Ds.description: Completed same-invocation source-resolution MediaCamera2D receipts. Omitted when no camera executes so historical frame-v2 manifests remain valid.

responsiveSlotMediaAnchors.description: Completed cross-receipts binding each slot-bound MediaCamera2D visualAnchor to the exact native camera frame, ResponsiveStack placement, and source/slot/composition coordinate chain.

identityComponentFragments.description: Completed zero-wrapper composition-space dispatch receipts for admitted public Visual component fragments.

retainedMediaLocalCompositors.description: Completed same-invocation V2 executions that materialize locked Image/Video islands beneath the bounded LocalSpace compositor. Omitted when none execute so historical frame-v2 manifests remain valid.

diagramLayouts.description: Completed public DiagramLayout pixels and exact planner decisions for the most recent scene-frame invocation. This v1 receipt does not claim a persistent cross-render raster cache.

planarTracks.description: Per-execution receipts admitted by the reference runtime's exact 4096 PlanarTrack executions-per-composition-frame cap.

localSpaceTransformPreflight.description: Completed same-invocation composition-wide admission and allocation envelope for every affine LocalSpace placement and MotionBlur sample. Optional for frozen frame-v2 compatibility; every current writer emits it, and component-fragment placement evidence requires it.

localSpaceExecutionTree.description: Closed ordered count/path/receipt digest for every current root and nested renderer execution. Required by the current writer profile; omitted only by frozen historical frame-v2 manifests.

localSpaceExecutions.description: Path-addressed same-invocation LocalSpace execution/preflight pairs for the root renderer and every contributing Precomp or NestedSequence renderer. Optional only for frozen frame-v2 compatibility; every current writer emits it and validates it against independently retained live-frame authority before publication.

anchoredPaths.description: Completed same-invocation resolution receipts for public anchored Path and MotionPath consumers. Omitted when no anchored consumer executes so historical frame-v2 manifests remain valid. Resolved receipts carry exact geometry and owner affine identities; policy-hidden receipts carry only the suppressing Track2D owner and a closed zero-raster-work proof.

semanticMatches.description: Completed same-invocation semantic-match halves. Omitted on frames with no active match so historical frame-v2 manifests remain byte-stable.
